data.geography_consistency: UUID identifiers everywhere. profiles FK(zone_id,province_id,country_id) REFERENCES zones(id,province_id,country_id); zones FK(province_id,country_id) REFERENCES provinces(id,country_id); UNIQUE referenced composites. AR-only countries.code. Official province/municipality/barrio catalog is NOT fabricated; AGE-34/37 load source with identity. Test geography explicitly synthetic.
data.main_photo_constraint: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX photos_one_main ON photos(profile_id) WHERE is_main; at most one principal. Every photo mutation locks profiles row; nonempty set exactly one main enforced by transaction; last deletion unpublishes. Limit5 enforced after lock.
data.transaction_lock: Subscription activation BEGIN SELECT users(id) FOR UPDATE before checking current subscription or key. All future subscription writers same lock; no overlapping current interval. Idempotency PK(user_id,key), payload_hash NOT UNIQUE. Other-account same plan can have equal hashes.
data.restart: Persist all users/profiles/photos/plan snapshots/subscription starts_at/ends_at/idempotency response/sessions/reset hashes. API restart does not re-seed users or renew dates. Migrations explicit, never implicit startup resets. Public expiry derived at query time, no timer required.

transaction: Before parsing any input: NODE_ENV=production returns403 simulation_disabled, zero auth/body/catalog/DB writes. Only server configured dev or staging allowed; unknown environment fails closed.

Authenticate owner; validate Idempotency-Key, JSON object exactly {plan_id}; reject unknown keys400 and unknown/disabled plan422. Server catalog ARS snapshot; origin=simulated. Never accept price/user_id/origin/simulated.
BEGIN; SELECT id FROM users WHERE id=:session_user_id FOR UPDATE; row exists. All subscription writers, including future Rebill handler, must take same users lock.

Read idempotency row scoped(user_id,key). If expires_at>transaction_now compare SHA256 canonical JSON of full accepted payload: sorted UTF8 keys, plan_id exact string, no whitespace. Same hash: return stored status/body after COMMIT, no mutation. Different hash: ROLLBACK and409 idempotency_conflict.
If expired: delete scoped row in transaction. If EXISTS subscription starts_at<=now AND ends_at>now, COMMIT purge and return409 active_subscription, without new subscription or extending dates.

Otherwise create subscription UUID; starts_at=one transaction timestamp, ends_at=starts_at+30*24h UTC (technical test default). Insert idempotency scope/hash/status201/body full Subscription DTO/expires_at=now+24h, in SAME transaction.

COMMIT before responding201. Any precommit error ROLLBACK both subscription and response;503 transaction_failed. If commit result is uncertain, no blind repeat by controller; owner may retry same key to reconcile stored201/body.

idempotency.payload_hash: SHA256 of complete accepted normalized JSON {plan_id}; reject unknown fields. Hash is NOT UNIQUE, account scope in composite PK.
idempotency.same_payload: Within24h return stored ORIGINAL status201 and exact same JSON response_body, same id/starts_at/ends_at; no new row or extension. Compare payload BEFORE active check.
idempotency.after_ttl: Expired scoped key can purge. If subscription active409 active_subscription with no extension; if expired a new simulated30d activation can create201. After TTL original replay guarantee ends; key in another account independent.
